column1: # Built furniture locs, keyed by dbcol.furniture:model_obj.

# vocabularies, so this mapping cannot be derived from the cache. It is transcribed
# from an OSRS 184 reference server, whose item ids match this cache's exactly.
# Several locs on a row are the parts of one multi-tile piece; which part goes where
# is decided by name, not by the order here.
